name: Sugar Rush Statement Necklace
sizes: ~15.5-17.5 inches; Adjustable chain extender for a flexible fit
materials: Ghanaian glass saucer beads, approximately 13–14 mm; Ethiopian brass gold-tone accents; high quality gold plated clasp and heart pendant
description:
A little candy-colored joy, made to make an entrance. Sugar Rush is a bold statement necklace featuring oversized Ghanaian glass saucer beads in a playful mix of pink, blue, green, and sunny yellow, finished with a polished gold-tone heart pendant. Ethiopian brass accents and gold-filled components.

The beads are made using a traditional Ghanaian powder-glass technique: colored glass is placed in clay molds and heated until the pieces fuse together. Each bead is about 13–14 mm across, so the necklace has plenty of color and presence. Small variations in color and pattern are part of the character of these handmade beads.
